images.title: One roti, three facts
images.purpose: Show one roti shared equally by 4 children, written three ways: as a division, an addition and a multiplication.
images.composition: One large roti on the left, and a column of three short fact lines on the right with wide spacing.
images.exact_structure: Left: one large round roti cut by two straight lines into 4 equal pieces; one piece filled teal #0072B2 and labelled 1/4, the other 3 pieces plain. Right: three fact lines stacked one under another with generous gaps, in dark text, the division line first, then the addition line, then the multiplication line. One thin grey #6B7280 arrow points from the teal piece toward the column. Exactly 1 roti, 4 equal pieces, 1 teal piece, 3 fact lines.

images.takeaway: One roti is four shares of 1/4.
images.description: A roti cut into 4 equal pieces with one piece teal and labelled 1/4; beside it the three facts 1 ÷ 4 = 1/4, 1 = 1/4+1/4+1/4+1/4 and 1 = 4 × 1/4.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the teal piece and read each fact line aloud, saying how it matches the roti.

image_decisions.why: Linking one roti picture to its three facts is clearer with the roti in view; one image carries it.
